question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**your**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• 
 
​​​​​​**Your:** ​​​​​​**Your** is an **adjective **that means** "relating to or belonging to you"**. It requires **nouns **after it__.

 __
 
• **Example: ***It's not **your **fault.*
 
 
 
• In the blank, we need an **adjective **that modifies the **noun "meals"** which is only shown by **"your".**
 
• All the other options don't show such meaning or are contextually incorrect.

 

Hence, option 4 is the correct answer. 

Complete Sentence__: *The variety of foods will make __your__ meals more interesting, too.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ **

__
 
• **Your's: Your's **is the** wrong word.** It is contracted form of **"your is"** or** "your has" **is also wrong in making sentences.
 
• **Yours: Yours__**__ is a **pronoun **that means** "that which belongs to you"**. ____It doesn't require **nouns **after it__.
 __
 
• **Example: ***Is this pen **yours**?*
 
 
 
• **You: **We use** "you" **to refer to the **person **or **people **being **spoken or written to**__.** **​
 
 
• Example: ***You **look nice.*
